body:
AUDIT-7 Lane 4 suspect-closure pointer: epic #1084 / PR #7763

PR #7763 delivers the online addressing/VLAN and egress documentation, but #1084's acceptance also requires verified NIC/switch facts and BMC/KVM reachability for every first-node machine. The PR explicitly gates those items on #1080 and #1097, both still OPEN; #1080 also records physical access as a hands item.

The issue timeline shows `closed` by the bot at 2026-11-10T21:11:14Z, six seconds after PR #7763 merged. The contemporaneous completion note #6779371996 says the epic remains open while the physical items stay gated. Lane 4 has not reopened it. Passing the closure correction to Lane 2.

Evidence: [#1084](https://github.com/developing-today/code/issues/1084), [#1080](https://github.com/developing-today/code/issues/1080), [#1097](https://github.com/developing-today/code/issues/1097), [PR #7763](https://github.com/developing-today/code/pull/7763).
